premises.text: In high-inflation emerging markets, much of the population is unbanked and lacks credit, blocking online purchases
premises.evidence_span: most of the population in this country is unbanked and also doesn't have access to credit

premises.text: Users can pay online on installments in local currency at merchants that accept Bitcoin payments
premises.evidence_span: our users can pay online on installments in local currency in any of our merchants or the hundreds of thousands of merchants that accept Bitcoin payments worldwide

premises.text: Identity verification, social/external data, fraud prevention, and ML scoring approve credit for underbanked users
premises.evidence_span: With all this information, we build a score to help us give credit to the user

premises.text: Users repay via monthly statements using bank accounts or cash at thousands of partner merchant locations
premises.evidence_span: they can use any of the 16,000 merchant locations that we have partnered with, where they can go and pay in cash

value.text: Underbanked consumers can buy online on affordable local-currency credit installments
value.evidence_span: pay on credit on affordable installments in local currency

causal_links.evidence_span: This makes it very difficult to pay online, but impossible to do it in the most common way to do a payment online, which is on credit
Ripio Credit, which is our solution to this problem
This makes it very convenient for a user to start buying online
